author: Bobby Grayson
description: (1) Dot-notation with a leading explicit Inv argument (HolderIs.srv hi hh) must be parenthesised when passed as an argument: hh.srv hi inside an application parses as (hh.srv) hi. (2) A local config named a shadows the counter def a; use unfold Lock.a. (3) Lemmas meant for dot-notation on Leanactors types (ReachE, CStepL) must be declared _root_.Leanactors.X.y inside the Lock namespace. (4) subst with p = server replaces p by server, so later references must say server. (5) The concurrent-agent node-id race: capture the id printed by deciduous add rather than assuming N+1 (one wrong edge 398->399 created and unlinked).
title: Toolchain notes from LockLive
